Job description : IOS Developer 
Location : Chicago, IL
Duration : Contract

Job Description:

• Overall 8-10 years of work experience
• 3-4 years of mobile development experience preferably in iOS
• 1-2 years of experience in Xamarin
• Experience in mobile banking will be a plus
• Take the lead of the frontend platform, in terms of development
• Participate in design and review meetings
• Collaborate with the UX team for wireframes interpretation to translate business requirements into technical specifications



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
